note: Lexicon for Inside the Log EP5 onward, Kokoro bm_daniel, speed 1.0, en-gb. Applied AFTER text respells and the Betaflight phoneme fix. Official manuscript files are not rewritten. Do not load the EP4 American 'log'->lˈɔːɡ rule: en-gb already yields lˈɒɡ (LOG, not lock), and that regex can distort 'analog'.

phoneme_subs.why: Fresnel as fruh-NELL, not FRESS-nuhl. Term-specific; this phoneme sequence is unique to Fresnel.
notch / notchy (inherited from EP3/EP4). Harmless if the word is absent.

betaflight_phoneme_fix.why: en-gb espeak says BEE-ta-flight; channel pronunciation is BAY-ta-flight
original EP2/EP4 en-us flap form, kept as a fallback

text_respell_note: See render_narration.py TEXT_RESPELLS and the generated respell log. Captions must keep the official English (NTSC, PAL, FPV, Blackbox, EasyQuadTune, etc.).
log_pronunciation: en-gb Kokoro already produces lˈɒɡ for 'log' and lˈɒɡz for 'logs'. EasyQuadTune is respelled to 'Easy Quad Tune' (phonemes ˈiːzi kwˈɒd tjˈuːn).
